extracted.summary: A general enquiry asking whether Lodestar lends for legal cases and about borrowing limits and rates, with no details of the matter given.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance. So that a member of the team can look at your enquiry properly, we need some further information: the type of matter (for example divorce or financial remedy proceedings, or an estate being administered), where the proceedings or estate are located, the amount you are looking to borrow, and the approximate value of the estate or the assets in dispute. It would also help to know whether a solicitor is instructed and, if so, the firm's name, the current stage of the matter, and any hearing or tax deadline dates. Once we have those details we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
